source_text: Et dixit Deus: Producat terra herbam foeni semen seminantis secundum genus, et lignum fructiferum faciens fructum, cuius semen in ipso est. Secundum litteram manifesti sunt fructus. Si iam facti sumus terra, non arida, afferamus fructus uberes Deo, ut benedicamur: Ecce odor filii mei sicut odor agri pleni. Terra enim saepe bibens imbrem et generans herbam opportunam percipiet benedictionem; quae spinas profert, adustionis finis est.
pass_a_gloss: And said God: Let-produce earth herb of-hay seed sowing according-to kind, and tree fruit-bearing making fruit, whose seed in itself is. According-to letter clear are fruits. If already made we-are earth, not dry-land, let-us-bring fruits rich to-God, that we-may-be-blessed: Behold smell of-son my as smell of-field full. Earth for often drinking rain and generating herb timely will-receive blessing; which thorns brings-forth, of-burning end is.
pass_b_english: [[God said: Let the earth put forth the herb of grass, seeding seed according to its kind, and the fruit tree making fruit whose seed is in itself >> Bible:Genesis 1:11]]. By the letter the fruits are plain. If we have already been made earth, not dry land, let us bring rich fruits to God, that we may be blessed: [[See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a full field >> Bible:Genesis 27:27]]. For earth that often drinks the rain and yields timely herb will receive blessing; that which brings forth thorns ends in burning.
